claims.text: Composition-order geometry (v15.98). Two source actions can expose weight-four information that neither exposes alone, and order is a separate contrast. Not merged to main. Does not show: a selected source law, Einstein, or derived time.
INVALID over a pretty predicate (v15.99). Rank covariance failed. Predicates that look true do not override validity. Not merged to main. Does not show: a scientific pass, or surviving entanglement.

Polar discontinuity on a physical path (v16.07–v16.08). Support-polar transport is discontinuous, including on paths that share a baseline. The contrast survives an identity middle, so it is not only an ordering effect. Not merged to main. Does not show: continuity of the old polar readout, a metric, or gravity.

Barriers that are not distances (v16.35). Eighteen pairs of consistency-equivalent retained states have a positive exact combinatorial barrier. Not merged to main. Does not show: a metric, an energy, time, or gravity.

18-pair completeness (v16.36). PR #81, merge ce4f0c0 on research/v16.34-fiber-component-invariant, not main. The canonical universe is enumerated and omissions, duplicates, and same-count substitutions are rejected. Audit 36731692842 reconstructed 18 records. Does not show: a barrier law, LOCAL_UNIT, or an independent predictive signature.

Gate D unresolved (v16.36). RESULTS.md is unchanged. A finite no-collision does not prove signature C determines the barrier. LOCAL_UNIT is not claimed. C still uses the certified barrier inside its feasible region. Does not show: a derived factorization, energy, geometry, or gravity.

Five-vertex unit barriers (v16.37). Every rooted unordered tree with at most five vertices and k in {1,2,3}: 51 graphs, 77 endpoint pairs, zero nonunit pairs. BOUNDED_UNIT_ONLY. Not on main. Does not show: a universal unit theorem, a metric, or gravity.

Six-vertex unit barriers (v16.38). Every rooted unordered tree with at most six vertices and k in {1,2,3}: 111 graphs, 1497 endpoint pairs, zero nonunit pairs. Merge e4de671. BOUNDED_UNIT_ONLY. Not on main. Does not show: a universal unit theorem, a metric, or gravity.

Saturation condition (v16.39). If SC holds, exact-fiber endpoints in different components have unit primary barriers and LEX_BARRIER (1,1,1). Reviewed as a sufficient-condition theorem. Not preregistered. No new numerical run. Not on main. Does not show: a characterization of every unit profile, a nonunit witness, or gravity.
Moving deviation (v16.40). One fixed tree. A unit path can change which coordinate deviates. Not on main. Does not show: a universal fixed-coordinate law, physical energy, or a STATUS bump.

Partition repair (v16.41). Partition profiles on finite rooted no-unary trees, k equal to the leaf count. Finite remainder had zero nonunit pairs. Not on main. Does not show: intrinsic indecomposability, every overlapping profile, or a universal unit law.
Overlapping core (v16.42). Reviewed T(d,m) family only. Not on main. Does not show: intrinsic indecomposability, or a universal unit law.

Star fibers (v16.43). Rooted stars are one exact component except the packed case m=k=q. That case has m! isolated components of one profile, every pair at barrier 1. Ten leaves and ten labels are 3628800 components. The two-label exchange is four incidence moves, then composed. The maximum excursion stays 1. Not on main. Does not show: that the profile determines the component, that height 1 means one move, nested trees, or a universal unit law.

Two internal vertices (v16.44). Admitted no-unary trees with exactly two internals. Barrier 1 between distinct exact components. Not on main. Does not show: three or more internals, or a universal unit law.

Binary fork (v16.45). Family theorem: every admitted binary root with two star children, arbitrary leaf degrees and palette size in that domain. Total L1 at most 1. Not one tested graph. Not on main. Does not show: chains, extra root children, every tree, or a physical evolution.
Non-saturated chain (v16.46). Outer target strictly below its degree. Not on main. Does not show: the saturated outer root, arbitrary trees, or a universal unit law.
Three-internal chains (v16.47), including the saturated outer root. Degrees at least 2. Not on main. Does not show: arbitrary branching, or a universal unit law.

Internal-chain induction (v16.48). PR #96, merge 0c0efebe on the integration branch, not main. Compact-palette induction for every finite internal chain, total L1 at most 1. Receipt cb086f9, workflow 36856450558. The older demo README still says PRE-CLOSURE. That is not the closure record. Does not show: arbitrary branching, a source, height 1 as one component, or a no-go against the retained structure.

Fork of two chains (v16.49). PR #97, merge a8280c1, not main. One binary parent, two internal-chain children. Closeout 9ffa81c approves CLOSED/CERTIFIED for that scope. Does not show: arbitrary trees, unit scored as failure, or a source.

Full binary trees (v16.50). PR #98, merge 4a28661, not main. Every internal has two children; balance is not required. Repaired children compose, and the total profile excursion stays at most 1. Palette width is max(a,b) or a+b as the parent hitting number is 1 or 2. The 1920 cases are directed checks. The induction carries the general claim. Does not show: every path, a short or unique evolution, higher arity, a nonunit witness, a mere uniform tax, or a source.

One ternary root (v16.51). PR #99, merge 76f373c, not main. Three full binary children, hitting number 2. 2592 directed cases. Repeated ternary composition was still open. The missed RED timing is disclosed. Does not show: a nonunit witness, or a STATUS bump.

Four-child interface (v16.53). PR #101, merge f6d4d79, not main. Internal arities 2, 3, and 4. Does not show: arity 5, or the counts as the theorem.
Floor-two connectivity (v16.54). PR #102, merge 496a403, not main. Hitting number stays in {q-1, q}. Does not show: higher floors, the global sum at most 1, or a physical barrier.
Bounded renewable guard (v16.55). PR #103, merge 3183c29, not main. R1–R5 implementation only. Run 37211847122 passed. Does not show: universal X15U root repair, X32, X33, or a source.

A11.X60 analytical checkpoint. Every prescribed permutation inside the stated colored carrier, not on main. Does not show: universal arbitrary-root minimum repair, or an obstruction to every temporary incidence.
A11.X61 analytical checkpoint. Sufficient hybrid-boundary batches, not on main. Does not show: three-cover necessity, universal existence, or X62–X64 as closed.

7 Oct index at 6a99418, not main. Auxiliary cycle breaking was the named next line. The 10 Oct tip does not keep it as the frontier. Does not show: that line as proved, B1/B2 closed, A12.6, a physical primitive, or a source.

Spare capacity is not reachable reserve (tip 1e7cd09). Not main. A non-isolated source can still leave spare labels unreachable. Does not show: a general impossibility, connectivity from a feasible count, or a source.
Scoped repair interfaces. Not main. Not broad C3. Does not show: guaranteed progress, universal one-incidence connectivity, or numbered v16 certification.
Count reconstructions do not derive access. Not main. Safe core writes do not initialize the hidden record. Does not show: a sensor, native C3 origin, or a source.

#nodarkmatter is program voice, not a DESI confirmation. DESI DR2 still uses CDM. Evolving dark energy is not a dark-matter result.

Grain this compile: badge, one sentence, harness or X-only, date. Status URLs sit on the cards.
